method: Per-task solve wall time reconstructed from the Cursor session timeline: from first reading the task instruction to the frozen, self-tested candidate (includes API exploration, prototyping, failed iterations, and full-length self-tests; excludes environment setup, official verification, stamping waits, and infrastructure fixes). Values are approximate to a few minutes. Token counts and service cost are not exposed to the agent by the Cursor harness and are therefore not reported (see REPORT.md harness note).

notes.01: two prototypes (MPS conversion validation, full-scale timing) + normalization fix + two full 500-step tests
notes.04: 16 min first solve (Kraus-ladder, later audit-rejected) + 14 min framework-native rewrite
notes.10: includes 2.9GB constant-capture OOM fix, contractor-hang fix, and two full-length tests
notes.12: fastest solve: pattern fully established by prior tasks
